texts.ch_assist_first: LynkAssist isubiza mbere. Umuntu ari hafi, ukanda rimwe gusa.
texts.ch_assist_found: Murakoze. Nabonye itumiza kandi ndoherereza itsinda ibisobanuro byaryo. Uzabona igisubizo hano.
texts.ch_assist_payment: Ubwishyu bugaragara ko bwishyuwe ari uko utanga serivisi z'ubwishyu abyemeje. Fungura Gucuruza, hanyuma Uyu munsi, urebe buri bwishyu n'aho bugeze.
texts.ch_conn_back_online: Wongeye kuba kuri interineti. Ubutumwa bwoherejwe: {n}.
texts.ch_conn_waiting_internet: Dutegereje interineti. Ubutumwa butegereje: {n}. Buzoherezwa bwonyine.
texts.ch_protected_note: Ubutumwa burinzwe iyo bwoherezwa n'iyo bubitswe.
texts.ch_reason_assistant_first: LynkAssist isubiza mbere; umuntu yinjira ubisabye.
texts.ch_reason_back_in_line: Uwafashaga yagiye, bityo ikiganiro gisubira mu mwanya wacyo ku murongo.
texts.ch_reason_fast_lane: Kirebana n'uburiganya, umutekano cyangwa kurinda abantu, bityo cyagiye ako kanya kuri iryo tsinda.
texts.ch_reason_least_busy: Uyu muntu yari afite ibiganiro bike bifunguye.
texts.ch_reason_only_one_on_shift: Ni wowe wenyine wari mu kazi.
texts.ch_reason_out_of_hours: Cyaje nyuma y'amasaha y'akazi, bityo kiba dosiye ifite igihe cyo gusubizwa.
texts.ch_reason_rule: Itegeko rya nyiri ubucuruzi kuri iri shami, iki gicuruzwa cyangwa uyu mukiriya.
texts.ch_reason_same_helper: Umuntu umwe ni we wagufashije ubushize.
texts.ch_reason_topic: Uyu muntu ni we ukurikirana iyi ngingo.
texts.ch_side_storefront: Ikiganiro cya Iduka ryo kuri murandasi: umuguzi wabonye ibyo watanze.
texts.ch_sign_finding: Turashaka umuntu wagufasha… Uri nimero {place} ku murongo.
texts.ch_stopped: Byahagaze. Igisubizo cyanditswe kugeza ubu kirabitswe.
texts.ch_warn_never_ask: Ibi bisa na nimero y'ikarita cyangwa kode. LynkOmni n'abakozi bayo ntibajya babisaba. Bizahishwa mbere yo koherezwa.
